metas.description:
★ 8.2 · 1977
Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with…

metas.name: The Empire Strikes Back
metas.description:
★ 8.4 · 1980
The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to…

metas.name: Return of the Jedi
metas.description:
★ 7.9 · 1983
Luke Skywalker leads a mission to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of Jabba the Hutt, the Emperor prepares to crush the Rebellion with a more powerful Death Star, and the Rebel fleet…

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
metas.description:
★ 6.6 · 1999
Anakin Skywalker, a young slave strong with the Force, is discovered on Tatooine. Meanwhile, the evil Sith have returned, enacting their plot for revenge against the Jedi.

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
metas.description:
★ 6.6 · 2002
Following an assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi investigate a mysterious plot into the heart of the Separatist movement and the…

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
metas.description:
★ 7.5 · 2005
When the sinister Sith unveil a thousand-year-old plot to rule the galaxy, the Republic crumbles and from its ashes rises the evil Galactic Empire. Jedi hero Anakin Skywalker must choose a side.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: Revenge of The Brick
metas.description:
★ 6.1 · 2005
Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi attempt to stop the Separatists from invading Kashyyyk. Meanwhile, Master Yoda must defeat an evil army of droids.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Quest for R2-D2
metas.description:
★ 5.6 · 2009
When R2-D2 gets lost in space, Anakin Skywalker and his apprentice Ahsoka Tano set off on a mission to find their droid pal.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: Bombad Bounty
metas.description:
★ 6.1 · 2010
Darth Vader hires Boba Fett to track down Jar Jar Binks, who has caused a lot of trouble for Vader. This leads Binks and Fett on a game of cat-and-mouse like never seen before.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Padawan Menace
metas.description:
★ 6.6 · 2011
Master Yoda must go retrieve secret battle plans. However, things become a little more complicated when a class of younglings join the mission.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Out
metas.description:
★ 6.5 · 2012
Luke Skywalker embarks on a mission to destroy an Imperial base, but is relentlessly chased by a group of fanatic girls who think of him as a celebrity. Meanwhile, Darth Vader engages a rivalry…

metas.name: Star Wars: The Force Awakens
metas.description:
★ 7.2 · 2015
Thirty years after defeating the Galactic Empire, Han Solo and his allies face a new threat from the evil Kylo Ren and his army of Stormtroopers.

metas.name: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
metas.description:
★ 7.5 · 2016
A rogue band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
metas.description:
★ 6.7 · 2017
Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

metas.name: Solo: A Star Wars Story
metas.description:
★ 6.5 · 2018
Through a series of daring escapades deep within a dark and dangerous criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his mighty future copilot Chewbacca and encounters the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian.

metas.name: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
metas.description:
★ 6.2 · 2019
The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.
